title: Group Employees of the Same Salary
summary: Keep employees whose salary is shared with at least one other employee and assign a team number by ascending shared salary.
outputFormat: Original employee columns plus team_id, ordered by team_id then employee_id.
tieRules: Equal salaries share one team_id; team_id is the dense rank of the shared salary, starting at 1.
edgeRules: Employees with unique salaries are excluded.

examples.label: authored-reference
examples.text: authored-reference: salaries 50,50,70,90,90 -> teams 1 (50) and 2 (90); salary 70 excluded.
